question: Do US common stocks whose quarterly revenue and net income improved year over year, and whose price reaction to the information was weak, earn SPY-relative excess returns after costs over 5/21/63 sessions, reproducibly in development and holdout?
observed_before_freeze: prevalidation coverage counts only (H_N1_PREVALIDATION_V1.md). No forward return, cohort outcome, reaction distribution or feature distribution was computed.
llm_use: PROHIBITED for any alpha, scoring, approval or ranking

data.submissions_merge: per CIK, union of filings keyed by accessionNumber
data.ticker_change_snapshots: all CS_*.json.gz under data/runtime, ordered by date
data.benchmark: SPY from the same grouped store

universe.rows: type CS with non-empty CIK, primary_exchange in XNYS, XNAS, XASE
universe.price_filter: unadjusted close on the signal-formation session >= 5.00 USD
universe.liquidity_filter: median close*volume over the 20 sessions ending at the signal-formation session >= 5,000,000 USD (reused from strategy_e_v1_1 daily eligibility); fewer than 20 sessions -> excluded
universe.ticker_mapping: start from the 2024-10-25 ticker; when it has no grouped row on a session, look up the same CIK in the newest CS snapshot dated on or before that session; if a different ticker is found and has a grouped row, continue on it from that session; record TICKER_CHANGED
universe.dedup: one event per (CIK, filingDate); earliest accessionNumber

event.diagnostic_form: 10-K exactly, annual YoY, never aggregated with primary
event.signal_formation_session: first XNYS session strictly after filingDate; information usable at its close
event.entry: OPEN of the session after the signal-formation session (no same-close entry)

fundamentals.as_known: every value is taken from rows with filed <= event filingDate; when several rows exist for the same period, the one with the latest filed <= event filingDate
fundamentals.current_period_10q: fact rows with accn == event accession and duration 80..100 days; latest end
fundamentals.current_period_10k: fact rows with accn == event accession and duration 350..380 days; latest end
fundamentals.prior_period: same tag, end 365 +/- 20 days before current end, duration within 15 days of current duration
fundamentals.tag_rule: first tag in order that has both current and prior; unit USD
fundamentals.F_minus: both fields evaluable AND NOT F_plus
fundamentals.missing: either field not evaluable -> NOT_EVALUABLE, excluded and counted

reaction.anchor: nearest preceding 8-K whose items contain 2.02, same CIK, filingDate in [event filingDate - 60 calendar days, event filingDate]; ties -> earliest accessionNumber; none -> the 10-Q itself
reaction.start: close of the last XNYS session strictly before the anchor filingDate
reaction.terciles: q33/q67 computed once on all DEVELOPMENT primary events passing universe filters and evaluable (F_plus and F_minus together); frozen and reused unchanged for HOLDOUT

returns.definition: h sessions counting the entry session as 1; exit at the CLOSE of session h; stock = exit_close_adj / entry_open - 1
returns.split_adjustment: for each split with execution_date in (entry session, exit session]: exit price *= split_to/split_from
returns.excess: stock return - SPY return over the same entry-open to exit-close window
returns.net: excess - cost, deducted once per event
returns.eligibility: an event enters horizon h only if the exit session h exists in the price store (<= 2026-10-12)
returns.delisting: no grouped row for the (mapped) ticker on any session from some session s <= exit through the last store session -> DELISTED_BEFORE_HORIZON; OBSERVED variant = last available close; CONSERVATIVE variant = stock return -100%
returns.other_gap: missing exactly on the exit session but present later -> use the next available close, flag EXIT_GAP
returns.overlap: each event is an independent observation; 63D diagnostic reports the share of windows containing the next 10-Q of the same CIK and the result truncated at that filing's signal-formation close

split.holdout_rule: nothing may change after holdout is read; changes require H_N1_CONTRACT_V2 evaluated on new data

statistics.bootstrap: block bootstrap, block = ISO week of the signal-formation session, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261019, 95% percentile CI of mean net excess
statistics.season: calendar quarter of the signal-formation session

sample.INSUFFICIENT: PRIMARY N < 100 in a split for that horizon

per_horizon_pass_all: DEV and HOLDOUT: mean net excess at 25 bp > 0 (OBSERVED delisting variant)
DEV and HOLDOUT: median net excess at 10 bp > 0
DEV: bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of mean net excess at 10 bp > 0
DEV and HOLDOUT: CONSERVATIVE delisting variant mean net excess at 10 bp > 0
DEV and HOLDOUT: top 5 events < 50% of the summed net excess at 10 bp, and mean net excess at 10 bp after removing the top 1% of events > 0
ALL SEASONS (DEV+HOLDOUT): mean net excess at 10 bp > 0 in at least 60% of seasons with N >= 30
DEV and HOLDOUT: mean excess at 0 bp of PRIMARY > mean excess at 0 bp of CONTRAST
persistence: every shorter primary horizon has mean excess at 0 bp >= 0 in both splits
gates.H_N1_PASS: 21D or 63D satisfies every per_horizon condition with sample OK
gates.BORDERLINE: 21D or 63D has positive mean net at 25 bp in both splits but fails CI, concentration, season, contrast, delisting sensitivity, or has WEAK_SAMPLE
gates.FAIL_SIGNAL: DEV mean excess at 0 bp <= 0 at 5D, 21D and 63D
gates.FAIL_COST_BOUND: some primary horizon has DEV mean at 0 bp > 0 but no horizon has DEV mean net at 25 bp > 0
gates.FAIL_HOLDOUT: DEV passes for a horizon but HOLDOUT mean net at 25 bp <= 0 for it
gates.INSUFFICIENT: PRIMARY N < 100 in either split at 21D and 63D

prohibited_after_freeze: changing universe, filters, tags, YoY rules, F_plus definition, reaction window, anchor rule, tercile cutoffs, horizons, costs, split dates, gates
adding feature combinations or cohorts as PRIMARY
promoting a diagnostic cohort to PRIMARY after results
runtime, scheduler, API, UI, paper broker before H-N2 PASS
separation: legacy Strategy H forward ledger is LEGACY_FORWARD_EVIDENCE and is never read by H-N1
